items.reason: The lower 2.5% strength is a gentler way to keep up with the breakout-prone look you mentioned, and it is the one to start with.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps with the lower moisture score and any dryness from a benzoyl peroxide wash.
A mineral SPF 50 protects skin during the day and suits sensitive, redness-prone skin.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day at first, rinse well, then follow with moisturizer, and apply sunscreen every morning. I have left out retinoids like adapalene and retinol, and stronger exfoliating acids, while you are trying for a baby, so please check any actives with your doctor or midwife before using them.
